content: Un'kyeey wàtyeen kan'bɛɛrà mfuŋ
Un'kyeey wàtyeen kàbɛɛrà mfuŋ. Mɛ kàmɛn mbwaar mwɛy kàbü u mɛɛn fà du. Bun'pɛ nsab a fu a un'baan.
Nde kàduub fu a un'baan. Un'diŋ mwɛy kàtoo kwo asànaa un'diŋ a yaaŋ a mbaa a kölàköl. Taaŋ anà un'pöb màkyer apiir.
Mpay yàkyer atoo uboo a un'diŋ awun, waa yàpää u mɛɛn. Ba bapɛ ikɔ̈b asànaa ikɔ̈b a nye a mɛɛn.
Nde kàtɛn a ma naa ma màkɔ̈ɔ̈n akyer ube akà iteerà a mɛɛn, akà nkay a mbu itàkal akà un'te mwɛy, wɛɛ akà baar mpɛl abye anà inyɛm a Nzam.
Ba bapɛ anki mbwo mukadwa, wɛɛ mukapà unkiiŋ mpɛl ngɔn tyeen. Usaay abà paa bà asànaa usaay a lànye làfàtà la mbuur.
Kà ilä abin, ba bàsàleŋ ukwà, wɛɛ ba, ba bàsàman anki ba. Ba bàsàkwen naa ba bàkü, wɛɛ ukwà bàkyer asatiin.
Mpay ayi yàkäl asànaa mpoonà aŋàlɔ̈ɔ̈n ntɔn ità. Udu a in'tswe aya yàkäl asànaa mpà a ibyääl yà wɔl, anà ntabwey aya yàkäl asànaa ntabwey a baar.
Ya yàkäl anà ntswe asànaa ntswe a akaar, anà an'din aya màkäl asànaa an'din a ntaamà.
Itɔl aya byàmɛnà asànaa byàŋàyee u kwam a ishabà, anà làso a an'paab aya làkäl asànaa làso a an'pusupusu a mpoonà mbɔɔn yàmudüül ità.
Mpay ya yàkäl anà in'kyel a nsyeenà asànaa myà nye. Yà unsà in'kyel aya waa ya yàkäl anà ikɔ̈b mukyer baar ube ngɔn tyeen.
Kà un'tswe aya, ya ye anà mfum, un'kyeey a un'baan. Ikɔb ande Abadɔ unsà Ɛbɛlyɔ, anà Apɔlyɔ unsà Ingɛlɛki.
Un'kyeey wàsyaam kan'bɛɛrà mfuŋ
Ngyɛb yàtàtwɛb yàkyàlyaaŋ. Ungö aya, ngyɛb yweel asin yàkyer afàyà.
Ungö, un'kyeey wàsyaam kàbɛɛrà mfuŋ. Mɛ kàwem ndaa mwɛy yan'fà kà an'twɛrà man'nà mà mɛsà a ibɔɔn mà wɔl amà kusà a Nzam.
Ndaa yan'tɛn a un'kyeey kàkäl anà mfuŋ naa: « Atsuuŋ akyeey banà abà bàŋàbäm, tsütsü a ngyäl a kölàköl, Ɛfrat. »
Waa bàtsuuŋ akyeey ba banà, abà bàlɔ̈ɔ̈n ntɔn taaŋ alà, ilä aki, ngɔn awà anà mbul awà ntɔn mudwa imwɛy uboo a itiir itär byà baar.
Ban'kyään un'tal a aŋità aba bàfàlaar udu a mpoonà: ba bàkäl nkam yweel yà nsaab nsaab.

Abun, unsà imanmii, mɛ kàmɛn mpoonà anà baar bàläärà udu aya: ya yàkäl yàŋàbwää inkur a kwam kyà tsöö asànaa mbaa, kyà bulɛ asànaa safir anà kyà sufre. In'tswe a mpoonà ya myàkäl asànaa myà ntaamà. Mbaa, un'diŋ anà sufre myàyatoo u mun aya.
Ntaaŋàmbar ayi yàtär: mbaa, un'diŋ anà un'twà a mbaa yàyatoo u mun a mpoonà, ya yàdwä itiir imwɛy uboo a itiir itär byà baar banswà.
Ntɔn ikɔ̈b a mpoonà kyà u mun anà kà in'kyel aya. Ntɔn in'kyel aya myà asànaa ntäy. Mya mye anà in'tswe myàfàsyääl ya ntɔn mukyer baar ube.

Kyekà baar bàsäl, baar mpa bàkü u ntaaŋàmbar ayi, ba bàwɛy anki nkääl aba. Ba bàwɛy anki mukömà insɔŋà anà itɛk a wɔl, byà arza, byà brɔnze, byà in'kul anà byà in'te, abyà mpa byan'kwo muman, itàkal muwem, itàkal mukyà dwaan.
Ba bàsɔɔmà anki sye ntɔn ba bàwɛy anki mudwa baar, mukyer inwɛŋ, mukyer ipasàsɛ anà muyib.
